NAME: Clock divider and reset controller verification plan
details: Blocks 21 and 22: clk_div and reset_ctrl. Source: GARUDA-CLKRST-SPEC-001 and decisions D-19, ADR-0003. Feature-level plan written 2026-10-04, before the UVM environment. Sign-off criteria: flow/0_signoff_criteria.md. The properties here are what the rest of the chip's no-synchroniser argument rests on, so most of them are also assigned to formal.

NAME: A Registers
details: reset_ctrl, APB window 9, 0x4000_9000. Spec section 6.

NAME: F01 RSTREASON records the cause of the last reset
details: Offset 0x00. Bit 0 EXT, 1 WDT, 2 NDM, 3 SW, 4 BOOTFAIL, bits 31:5 read 0. Exactly one of bits 0 to 3 is set by a reset. Spec 6.1, [N-6.2].
implementation_note: Method: sim (register model) + formal. Before the UVM environment: tb_crg t_rst_reason. Now: all 2 items passing.

NAME: a_reason_onehot
details: After any reset exactly one of bits 3:0 has been set by it.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/reset_ctrl/reset_ctrl_sva.sv, bound to reset_ctrl. Passing in the 22 UVM runs, tb_crg, tb_timers and the chip tests; seen to trigger. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: cg_rst_reason.cp_cause
details: Each of the four hardware causes; BOOTFAIL set by software; two causes in a row without a clear.
implementation_note: crg_coverage in tb/clk_div/uvm/crg_env_pkg.sv. 100 percent in the merged 22 runs.

NAME: F02 RSTREASON survives every reset except the external one
details: Its flops are reset by ext_rst_n only. Requirement R-8, spec [N-6.1].
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Before the UVM environment: tb_crg t_rst_reason. Now: all 1 items passing.

NAME: a_reason_survives_wdt
details: The register is unchanged across a watchdog, debug or software reset except for the new cause bit.
implementation_note: a_reason_survives in rtl/reset_ctrl/reset_ctrl_sva.sv, bound to reset_ctrl. Passing in the 22 UVM runs, tb_crg, tb_timers and the chip tests; seen to trigger. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: F03 RSTREASON bits clear when written 1
details: Writing 0 has no effect. BOOTFAIL (bit 4) is set by writing 1 to RSTCTL bit 4 - not in the specification, read from the RTL - and cleared like the others. Spec [N-6.3].
implementation_note: Method: sim (register model). Before the UVM environment: tb_crg W1C. Now: all 2 items passing.

NAME: ral_access RSTREASON
details: Write-1-to-clear policy on each bit.
implementation_note: crg_reg_test in tb/clk_div/uvm (register model generated from Design_Docs/regs/crg.rdl) and the expected values in crg_directed_test. Passing.

NAME: cg_rst_reason.cp_clear
details: Each bit cleared alone; clear in the cycle a new cause arrives.
implementation_note: crg_coverage in tb/clk_div/uvm/crg_env_pkg.sv. 100 percent in the merged 22 runs.

NAME: F04 RSTCTL.SWRST requests a full reset and clears itself
details: Offset 0x04 bit 0, write-only. The reset is full length and the reason is SW. Spec 6.2. The write is cut short by the reset it causes, so its DIVSEL bits do not land (BUGS.md CRG-3).
implementation_note: Method: sim. Before the UVM environment: tb_crg. Now: all 1 items passing.

NAME: sb_reset
details: The reference model expects a reset of at least 1024 reference cycles and RSTREASON bit 3.
implementation_note: crg_scoreboard sb_reset - every reset measured on the pins in reference cycles, with its sources and what it reached - 1295 system resets and 368 core-only resets in 22 runs, 0 mismatches. Expected causes are written out in crg_directed_test.

NAME: F05 RSTCTL.DIVSEL selects the divide ratio and is not reset by SWRST
details: Bits 9:8, read-write, reset 00. Reserved bits ignore writes and read 0. Spec [N-6.5].
implementation_note: Method: sim (register model). Before the UVM environment: tb_crg t_div_sel. Now: all 2 items passing.

NAME: ral_access RSTCTL
details: Read-back of bits 9:8; the rest read 0.
implementation_note: crg_reg_test in tb/clk_div/uvm (register model generated from Design_Docs/regs/crg.rdl) and the expected values in crg_directed_test. Passing.

NAME: a_divsel_survives_swrst
details: DIVSEL is unchanged across a software reset.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/reset_ctrl/reset_ctrl_sva.sv, bound to reset_ctrl. Passing in the 22 UVM runs, tb_crg, tb_timers and the chip tests; seen to trigger.

NAME: F06 CLKSTAT shows the ratio in effect the busy flag and the boot select pin
details: Offset 0x08, read-only. Bits 1:0 DIVACT, bit 2 DIVBUSY, bit 8 the boot_sel pin (decision D-19). A write is ignored and raises no error (BUGS.md AUD-13).
implementation_note: Method: sim. Before the UVM environment: tb_crg reads DIVACT. Now: all 1 items passing.

details: The set of pclk edges is a subset of the hclk edges. This is the reason no synchroniser is needed between the two anywhere in the chip. Spec [N-7.4].

NAME: F12 pclk_phase marks the hclk cycle before each pclk rising edge
details: High for exactly one hclk cycle in two. Spec [N-7.4].
implementation_note: Method: formal + sim. Before the UVM environment: tb_crg. Now: all 1 items passing.

NAME: a_pclk_phase
details: pclk_phase_o is 1 exactly in the hclk cycle that ends with a pclk rising edge.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/clk_div/clk_div_sva.sv, bound to clk_div; measured in time on the pins. Passing in the 22 UVM runs, tb_crg, tb_timers and the chip tests; seen to trigger. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: F14 A ratio change is glitch free
details: No hclk or pclk pulse is shorter than the shorter of the two ratios' half periods; DIVBUSY is set while the change is pending; the new ratio starts at a pclk_phase boundary. Spec [N-6.4], [N-7.5].
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Before the UVM environment: tb_crg t_div_switch_glitch. Now: all 2 items passing.

NAME: a_div_no_glitch

implementation_note: SVA in rtl/clk_div/clk_div_sva.sv, bound to clk_div; measured in time on the pins. Passing in the 22 UVM runs, tb_crg, tb_timers and the chip tests; seen to trigger. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: F15 A second DIVSEL write while a change is pending
details: The last value written is the one that takes effect - the request register follows DIVSEL on every always-on cycle until the dividers are all low. Not in the specification; read from the RTL. No glitch either way.
implementation_note: Method: sim. Before the UVM environment: no check. Now: all 1 items passing.
